Questions and Answers_N6426726R3002 posted as of 03/19/2026.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This solicitation is for a task order under the SeaPort-NxG Multiple Award Contract (MAC) and is open exclusively to active SeaPort-NxG MAC Prime holders, in accordance with FAR 16.505. Proposals submitted by non-MAC holders will not be evaluated. This task order is set aside for SBA-certified 8(a) program participants. As these are non-commercial support services, refer to the attachments for additional details. Note: Only Prime MAC holders on the SeaPort-NxG MAC are eligible for award.
